title: the unwise choice
simplified_paragraphs: 春秋的时候，有一个卖珠宝的商人。
他用很贵的材料，做成很多漂亮的小盒子，使盒子有香味，然后把珠宝放在盒子里面。
有一次他去卖珠宝。有一个人，看见珠宝盒子特别漂亮，问了多少钱以后，就买了一个。这个人打开盒子，把里面的珠宝拿出来，还给珠宝商人，带走了盒子。
现在人们说“买椟还珠”，意思是有的人只觉得外表重要而不看内容，不要重要的东西而选择不重要的东西，这不聪明。
traditional_paragraphs: 春秋的時候，有一個賣珠寶的商人。
他用很貴的材料，做成很多漂亮的小盒子，使盒子有香味，然後把珠寶放在盒子裡面。
有一次他去賣珠寶。有一個人，看見珠寶盒子特別漂亮，問了多少錢以後，就買了一個。這個人打開盒子，把裡面的珠寶拿出來，還給珠寶商人，帶走了盒子。
現在人們說“買櫝還珠”，意思是有的人只覺得外表重要而不看內容，不要重要的東西而選擇不重要的東西，這不聰明。
pinyin_paragraphs: Chūn qiū de shí hou， yǒu yī gè mài zhū bǎo de shāng rén。
tā yòng hěn guì de cái liào， zuò chéng hěn duō piào liang de xiǎo hé zi， shǐ hé zi yǒu xiāng wèi， rán hòu bǎ zhū bǎo fàng zài hé zi lǐ miàn。

yǒu yī cì tā qù mài zhū bǎo。 yǒu yī gè rén， kàn jiàn zhū bǎo hé zi tè bié piào liang， wèn le duō shao qián yǐ hòu， jiù mǎi le yī gè。 zhè gè rén dǎ kāi hé zi， bǎ lǐ miàn de zhū bǎo ná chū lái， huán gěi zhū bǎo shāng rén， dài zǒu le hé zi。
xiàn zài rén men shuō“ mǎi dú huán zhū”， yì si shì yǒu de rén zhǐ jué de wài biǎo zhòng yào ér bù kàn nèi róng， bù yào zhòng yào de dōng xi ér xuǎn zé bù zhòng yào de dōng xi， zhè bù cōng míng。
english_paragraphs: During the Spring and Autumn period, there was a merchant who sold jewelry.
He used expensive materials to make many beautiful little boxes, gave them a pleasant scent, and then put the jewelry inside.

One day, he went to sell his jewelry. A customer thought one of the boxes was especially beautiful. After asking the price, he bought it. He opened the box, took out the jewelry, returned it to the merchant, and left with the box.

Today, people use the saying “buying the box and returning the pearl” to describe someone who cares only about appearances and ignores what is inside, choosing something less important over something more important. That is not a wise choice.
english_full:
During the Spring and Autumn period, there was a merchant who sold jewelry.

He used expensive materials to make many beautiful little boxes, gave them a pleasant scent, and then put the jewelry inside.

One day, he went to sell his jewelry. A customer thought one of the boxes was especially beautiful. After asking the price, he bought it. He opened the box, took out the jewelry, returned it to the merchant, and left with the box.

Today, people use the saying “buying the box and returning the pearl” to describe someone who cares only about appearances and ignores what is inside, choosing something less important over something more important. That is not a wise choice.
